title: Error-tolerant secure key leasing for quantum decryption keys in public-key encryption
summary: We propose the first error-tolerant secure key leasing (SKL) for public-key encryption. As with SKL in prior works, our protocol consists of a lessor and lessee. In the protocol, the lessor encodes its secret key into quantum states and leases the key to the lessee. Then, the lessor can ask the lessee to return the secret key at a later point. The lessor is able to check whether the lessee has returned its key honestly. However, our protocol works even when the leased secret key is subject to noise.
